subject: Post-demo: security questionnaire kickoff + logs/backup erase-window clarification
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Morgan <alice.morgan@complihealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-03-22T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: security questionnaire kickoff + logs/backup erase-window clarification

Hi Alice — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Good energy from your team and a clear list of operational constraints on your side. As promised, a brief recap and a few targeted asks so we can move the security questionnaire and retention evidence work forward.

Recap (short):
- You run a mixed SaaS + on-prem data flow for PHI ingestion; HIPAA is required for several customers.
- Your security team is primarily focused on: SOC 2 status, data residency, log access, and backup retention/erase windows.
- You requested a clear statement of our deletion workflow and how we handle backups and snapshots.

Asks / next steps:
1) SOC 2: Can you confirm whether you require our SOC 2 Type II report (full report) or an assertion letter and whether you have a preferred time-window for the period covered? We can provide the most recent Type II report under NDA.
2) Logs & backups: Please confirm the exact retention window you require for application logs vs. audit logs vs. backups/snapshots. Below are our typical defaults; if you have narrower constraints we can discuss options:
   - Application logs (request/response): 90 days by default, configurable per-customer.
   - Audit logs (admin actions, policy changes): 2 years, immutable.
   - Backups / snapshots: 30–90 days depending on SLA profile; deletion of backups is a separate workflow with snapshot tombstoning + crypto-erase.
3) Deletion evidence: We can supply confirmation of deletion and a sample DB-erase transcript for an erase-window test. Do you need evidence tied to individual customer requests or periodic audit bundles?
4) Vendor questionnaire: If you can share your security questionnaire (PDF/Word) we’ll start filling it and route to our compliance team. Alternatively, we can pre-populate the answers for common sections (encryption, key management, access controls).

Attachments: I’m attaching a short retention_matrix for us to use as a starting point. Ben will also share a short FAQ on backup deletion workflow.

Proposed timeline: share questionnaire this week -> draft answers + evidence pack in 3 business days -> follow-up call for any clarifications next week. Does Friday 3/24 at 10am PT work for a 30-min sync?

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Post-demo: security questionnaire kickoff + logs/backup erase-window clarification

Hi Jordan — thanks for the clear recap and the matrix. Short answers inline below.

SOC 2: We need the full SOC 2 Type II report (last 12-month period) for our procurement team. NDA is fine.

Retention windows: our baseline requirements are:
- Application logs: 30 days (we may request aggregated metrics longer, but raw logs 30d)
- Audit logs (security/admin): 24 months
- Backups/snapshots that could contain PHI: 45 days max; after that we need documented secure deletion and proof of erasure.

Deletion evidence: For any customer-specific erase request we require a deletion confirmation letter plus a machine-readable evidence artifact (hash + timestamp) for backups and primary DB. Periodic audit bundles are acceptable for broader checks but not in place of per-request evidence.

Questionnaire: attaching our vendor security questionnaire (VSA_CompliHealth_SECURITY_2028.pdf). Please route to your compliance team; we expect a draft back within 5 business days.

Friday 3/24 10am PT works for a 30-min call — adding a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Alice Morgan
Head of Security Operations, CompliHealth
alice.morgan@complihealth.com

Subject: Re: Post-demo: security questionnaire kickoff + logs/backup erase-window clarification

Hi Alice — looping in a couple of specifics from our compliance team and listing the evidence we can provide.

What we can provide (initial):
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12-month period) via secure share under NDA.
- Per-request deletion confirmations: a signed deletion letter + system log extract showing the delete job id, timestamp, and rollback check results.
- Backup deletion: our backup system marks snapshots for purge, then performs a cryptographic wipe of the objects; logs are retained for the purge event. We can provide a backup-purge transcript (sample) and a hash-based evidence artifact.
- Audit log retention: configurable; default is 24 months. We can scope to 24 months for CompliHealth.

Notes on implementation details (brief):
- Application logs: raw request/response can be truncated at collection time and routed to short-term storage (30d) while aggregated metrics persist longer. We can offer a customer-specific policy to keep raw logs for 30 days.
- Backups: we offer snapshot lifecycle policies and an SLA-backed purge window. For DH-4912 we can configure a 45-day backup retention and provide proof per deletion event.

Attachments: I’ve attached a short one-pager that outlines the backup purge workflow and an example of the deletion evidence artifact. Also added a screenshot of our admin console log-retention settings.

Action items I’ll take on:
1) Share SOC 2 NDA link and expected delivery path by EOD today.
2) Prepare the draft answers to the VSA and return in 3 business days.
3) Prepare a sample deletion evidence bundle (backup and DB sample) for the call.

If you need anything before the call, call my mobile.

Best — Ben
